name: Provenance / transformation lineage (AX-06, AX-13)
families: no-provenance: artifacts carry no origin record
post-hoc-model-influenceable-logs: free-form logging written after actions, mutable by or through the acting model; includes aggregate-only ledgers (base/result hash + step count)
structured-prov-graphs: typed W3C-PROV-style provenance records as first-class data (absorbs: PROV-AGENT agent-centric extension)

per-step-recompute-DAG: every transformation committed as (input-hash, deterministic-op-id, output-hash), chained under a domain-separated Merkle root inside the signed release identity, third-party re-executed and byte-compared, census-total over the release closure (the AX-06 guarantee profile; absorbs: verified parsing of signed evidence envelopes — EverParse/Pulse over COSE/CBOR making malformed-provenance structurally unrepresentable, replay-divergence-proof audit semantics candidate — each journal entry bound to exact model/kernel identity with divergence detection on re-execution)

pre-action-independent-receipts: cryptographic receipt written by an independent gate BEFORE each action executes — an audit trail the model cannot influence, with deterministic replay as a design requirement (absorbs: agrepl transport-boundary record/replay fidelity-1.0, Signet/Agent-Receipts, ISO-42001/EU-AI-Act-Art.12 anchoring)

proof-carrying-state-updates: succinct proofs attached to each delta attesting the delta AND its causal history satisfy the validity predicate — O(1) validation without replay (absorbs: PC-CRDT PaPoC 2025, hash-chronicle causal binding). CONSISTENCY QUALIFICATION (CA P2-14): the succinct proofs here cover update-validity predicates over bounded structures, NOT whole-pipeline arithmetization; this is consistent with the v2 AX-13/AX-18 split, under which recompute-and-compare and TRANSPARENT proof-of-recomputation (STARK-class, no trusted setup, same hash-assumption family as the SHA-256 commitments) are equally maximal in assurance, and any exclusion of succinct systems is a RESOURCE_BOUNDED toolchain/arithmetization-cost clause, never a trusted-setup claim
